column1: # §7.6 Dose scheme and Repetition/multiplication. Dose scheme: three or
# four hyphen-joined groups (≤200, or next to a dosing-unit/context word)
# read via Cardinal, pause-comma separated (Telephone convention), never
# "minus" and never collapsed into Range. Repetition: N(x|×) fuses into
# one cardinal+"mal" word whenever N is a plain integer, regardless of what
# follows; a decimal N stays a separate "mal" (§7.6). Shapes reflect German
